C0300.title: Inlet Valve Front Left Performance
C0300.description: The front left inlet solenoid valve does not respond hydraulically as expected during ABS self-test.

causes.label: Valve stuck due to brake fluid debris

C0301.title: Air Suspension Compressor Relay
C0301.description: The air suspension control module has detected a fault in the compressor relay circuit. The compressor cannot be energized which prevents the system from refilling the air struts and ride height drops over time.

C0302.title: Outlet Valve Front Left Performance
C0302.description: The front left outlet solenoid valve does not respond hydraulically as expected.

C0303.title: Inlet Valve Front Right Performance
C0303.description: The front right inlet solenoid valve does not respond hydraulically as expected.

C0304.title: Outlet Valve Front Right Performance
C0304.description: The front right outlet solenoid valve does not respond hydraulically as expected.

C0305.title: Inlet Valve Rear Left Performance
C0305.description: The rear left inlet solenoid valve does not respond hydraulically as expected.

C0306.title: Ride Height Sensor Front Left
C0306.description: Ride Height Sensor Front Left: the control module has detected this fault condition. Without this signal the suspension control module cannot self-level the vehicle.

C0307.title: Inlet Valve Rear Right Performance
C0307.description: The rear right inlet solenoid valve does not respond hydraulically as expected.

C0308.title: Ride Height Sensor Front Right
C0308.description: Ride Height Sensor Front Right: the control module has detected this fault condition. Without this signal the suspension control module cannot self-level the vehicle.

C0309.title: Outlet Valve Rear Right Performance
C0309.description: The rear right outlet solenoid valve does not respond hydraulically as expected.

C0310.title: Ride Height Sensor Rear Left
C0310.description: Ride Height Sensor Rear Left: the control module has detected this fault condition. Without this signal the suspension control module cannot self-level the vehicle.

C0312.title: Ride Height Sensor Rear Right
C0312.description: Ride Height Sensor Rear Right: the control module has detected this fault condition. Without this signal the suspension control module cannot self-level the vehicle.

C0317.title: Compressor Relay Circuit
C0317.description: The air suspension control module has detected a circuit fault on the compressor relay output — typically open circuit, short to ground or short to power. Self-levelling is disabled and the vehicle may sit lower than normal.

causes.label: Compressor motor shorted, dragging supply down

C0327.title: Encoder Motor
C0327.description: The transfer case control module has detected a fault in the encoder motor used to shift between 2WD and 4WD ranges. A fault prevents range changes and may leave the transfer case in an undefined position.

causes.label: Encoder motor failed (worn brushes or seized)

C0374.title: 4WD Drive Coupling
C0374.description: The 4WD or AWD control module has detected a fault on the electronic drive coupling that distributes torque between axles. Reduced torque transfer or a complete loss of all-wheel drive function may result.

C0376.title: Front Axle Disconnect
C0376.description: The 4WD control module has detected a fault on the front axle disconnect actuator. On part-time AWD vehicles this actuator decouples the front axle for fuel saving, and a fault prevents engagement or disengagement of front-wheel drive.

C0387.title: Transfer Case Position Sensor
C0387.description: The transfer case control module has detected an implausible signal from the position sensor that reports the current shift position (2HI, 4HI, 4LO, neutral). Without a valid position the system cannot complete a range change.

C0388.title: Transfer Case High Range Switch Circuit Malfunction
C0388.description: The transfer case control module has detected an implausible state from the high range (4H) position switch. Range selection in 4WD mode may be limited.

C0389.title: Transfer Case Low Range Switch Circuit Malfunction
C0389.description: The transfer case control module has detected an implausible state from the low range (4L) position switch. Engagement of low range may be inhibited.

C0399.title: 4WD Mode Switch Circuit Malfunction
C0399.description: The transfer case or 4WD control module has detected an invalid signal from the driver-operated 4WD mode selector. Mode requests from the dashboard may be ignored.
